term: For research and education. Not a medical device; not for primary diagnosis.
translation: Za raziskave in izobraževanje. Ni medicinski pripomoček; ni namenjen primarni diagnostiki.
note: Safety text of the Home screen: translate in full, never shorten or soften.
The first, final diagnosis of a case: »ni namenjen primarni diagnostiki«.
Agree in gender with the subject (»ni namenjeno diagnostiki« for a predicted image or value). Never weaken to »ni priporočljivo«.
The phrase printed on RUO reagents; keep RUO. »NAPOVEDANO — samo za raziskovalno uporabo, ni namenjeno diagnostiki«.
Computed by an algorithm. Never »umeten«, »lažen« or »simuliran«.
Noun: »napoved« (a prediction is not a measurement).
Computed by a model or an algorithm: »generirana slika«.
Histological slide and its scan (»histološki preparat«). Never »diapozitiv« or »drsnik«. The glass itself: »objektno steklo«.
One open slide in a pane, as in a browser. Not »zaznamek« (that is a bookmark).
One of the side-by-side viewing areas: »poveži podokna«, gen. pl. »podoken«.
A section of the window (Channels, Plugins, Measurements…): »plošča Vtičniki«.
What a pane shows (position, magnification, rotation): »prejšnji pogled«.
The area of a pane where the slide is drawn.
The small overview of the whole slide with the visible area marked.
The bar showing a physical length (µm, mm).
Panels floating over the slide: »plavajoča plošča z metapodatki«.
The bar listing the slides and folders of the current folder.
Screen scale (100 % = one slide pixel per screen pixel). Zoom in/out: »Povečaj«/»Pomanjšaj«.
Objective-equivalent optical magnification; 20× stays 20×. Where both meet: »optična povečava« vs. »digitalna povečava«.
Unit px stays. Plural: 1 slikovna pika, 2 slikovni piki, 3 slikovne pike, 5 slikovnih pik.
Level-0 pixels: »slikovne pike ravni 0«. Not »ravnina« (that is a focal plane).
Patch extraction: »izrezovanje izsekov«. The dataset dialog's »Tile Size« is the patch size: »Velikost izseka«.
Measure mode of a polyline (several segments).
A drawn mark with a meaning; a free-text comment is »komentar«.
Graphics drawn over the slide: »prekrivna plast«; the dimming outside a region: »prekrivanje«.
Keep HPF as the abbreviation: »polje HPF«, »mitoze na 10 HPF«.
The method or type: »barvanje H&E«, »normalizacija barvanja«, series order »Barvanje«.

term: stain (one dye of a stain model)

note: Macenko and Vahadane stay undeclined: »normalizacija barvanja (Macenko)«.
The appearance normalisation maps slides onto: »uporabi kot ciljno barvanje«.
Estimating a slide's stain vectors: »barvila se še ocenjujejo«.
Marker names (CD3, Ki-67, PanCK…) are never translated.
Marks of a marker pen on the glass.
Menu item »Izvozi sliko …«; dialog title »Izvoz slike«.
Remove patient-identifying data (label, macro image, metadata). Adjective: »brez identifikacijskih podatkov«. Not »anonimiziraj«, which promises more.
Photo of the whole glass slide.
A saved view of a slide. Plural: 1 zaznamek, 2 zaznamka, 3 zaznamki, 5 zaznamkov.
The patient case (accession) slides belong to.
Slide properties as the scanner wrote them.
CPU and GPU stay as they are.
Asks before going online; never imply automatic background updates.
The notification list in the status bar.
Not »referenčna« (reserved for reference stain vectors and targets).
Another pathologist reading the same slide.
Lowercase and undeclined; masculine agreement (»eov se je zaprl«), or »program eov« where a case ending is needed.
Instructions and questions use the polite plural: »Odprite preparat«, »Ali želite …?«.
Buttons and menu items use the imperative (2nd person singular), sentence case.
A plugin, an input, a heat map, a region of interest.
»Počisti nedavne datoteke«, »Počisti sporočila«; landmarks or a region of interest: »Odstrani …«.
»Razveljavi: {}«; undo-step labels are verbal nouns (»Dodajanje meritve«).
Language names are capitalised list entries: »Nemščina«.
Key names (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Esc, Enter, F1) stay as they are.
eov updating itself (eov update); not »samodejno posodabljanje«.
A property the file does not record.
Status pattern that avoids gender agreement with a name.
Four forms: form 0 for 1, 101…; form 1 (dual) for 2, 102…; form 2 for 3, 4, 103…; form 3 for 0, 5–20…; every form shows {n}. Verbs agree: je / sta / so / je (neuter).
Kept at the end of items that open a dialog; written with a space before it after a whole word (»Shrani …«, »Nalaganje …«).
Space before units and %; none before the ° of an angle; 1024 × 768 px. Times: 1 h 02 min, 4 min 05 s.
The pane badge and figure note of stain normalisation: »Barve normalizirane (Macenko)«.
The tool that moves the view.
Panes showing the same slide move together.
Short row label in the image adjustments panel.
The Slovenian alphabet ends with Ž.
Show one channel alone: »Pokaži samo kanal {}«.
»(skript)« after a job started by a script.
A running task in the status bar, which can be cancelled.
Gamepad plugin; the device class: »igralni plošček«.
Plugin undo labels are verbal nouns too: »Dodajanje točke«, »Brisanje {n} anotacij«, »Uvoz {n} anotacij«; the same text also serves as a confirm-dialog title (»Brisanje plasti«).
Annotations without a class: »prikazane bodo kot nerazvrščene«.
Annotation status (»Stanje pregleda«); undo labels: »Označitev kot preverjeno«.
A point placed with the Count tool; the Count tab and tool: »Štetje«, »orodje Štetje (C)«.

translation: obris, ki se seka sam s seboj; samopresečišče
note: »Obris se je sekal sam s seboj«; »obris s samopresečišči«.
Microscopy Bulk Simple Annotations (IOD name) stays in English.
A placed point in the example plugin; not »označevalec«, which is a protein marker.
Never plain »celica«, which reads as a biological cell: »{done} od {n} mrežnih celic«.
Square image a model predicts from: »okno 256×256 px«, »{n} oken napovedi«.
Range of values a marker colour is drawn over: »Razpon prikaza za {} (arcsinh)«.

term: readout columns: mean / spread / density r²
note: Narrow columns of the Cellaris region readout; spread is the standard deviation (»razpršenost«).
Model downloads in Cellaris and eovae.
Controls assigned to actions; action names are imperatives like eov's shortcuts (»Premakni pogled vodoravno«).

term: shoulder button / face button (South, East, North, West)
translation: ramenski gumb / spodnji, desni, zgornji, levi gumb
note: Face buttons are named by position.
»Omogoči / začasno ustavi«; »Igralni plošček je začasno ustavljen«.
